questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: For me, it was important to choose a city that resembled what I'm already familiar with and wasn't too far away.

questions.answer: I generally think there has been good support available, both from my home university and the host university – whether it's regarding teaching, courses, housing, etc.

questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I got my off-campus accommodation through the host-university, so it was not difficult to find

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: I had an over-all good experience with living off-campus

Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: The process was divided into several stages, including the online learning agreement, final course selection, etc. Overall, it was a manageable process, and the various steps were well explained.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: It was possible to contact the host university, and their response time was quick, and they were very helpful.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the courses I applied for.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: If you simply follow the steps and start early, the process is really smooth.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I think the level of the courses is very similar to that of a bachelor's course at the University of Copenhagen, so there wasn't much of a difference to notice.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It was very similar to the University of Copenhagen, with lectures attended by 100+ students combined with seminar teaching, where we were divided into smaller groups.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
1) Social trends, Social Problems, and Social Policies 
2) Milestones in Communication Science 
3) Global Digital Cultures: Interdisciplinary Perspectives 
4) Topic Always Connected: Key Insights in Youth, Media, and Technology

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I have enjoyed all my courses, but in the course Social Trends, Social Problems, and Social Policies, you learn a lot about Dutch history, politics, culture, society, etc., which is always interesting when living in a new country.

Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: I have not researched what different offers are available

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I can recommend buying a museum card, which gives free access to many different museums, not only in Amsterdam, but in general in the Netherlands. There are also many nice cities not far from Amsterdam that are easy and cheap to visit.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: There are many pleasant things to experience in Amsterdam, e.g. their many markets, canal tour trips, museums and restaurants.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Amsterdam is very similar to Copenhagen, so it was easy to adapt.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: We had group work across both exchange and local students, where you can easily strike up a conversation with each other.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: There was not anything in particular that I found difficult.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The generally nice and hospitable people.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1) Be open and positive to new people and experiences
2) If possible, choose accommodation where you live with other students
3) Remember to enjoy it, time flies

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: It is generally clear and easy to get help.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: You become independent in a different way by living abroad alone.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: That you are far away from everything you know, and feel comfortable around.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
